profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CoreLogic
profile.summary:
Technology Lover

As I was growing up, I was inspired by latest technologies advancements at that time. Soon, I felt in love with the creativity coming technologies. I then decide to dead focus on Computer Science. Fast forward to at beginning of my career while I was still a student at UC Berkeley, my first computer science job tasked me with web UI development. Immediately I was hooked and again dead focus on doing web UI developments. I followed this career passion to jobs at UI San Diego, Directtv and Morphotrak.

However, my career take a turn a different direction at Resolve Systems, all of my skill sets soon to get a good used here by solving customer facing issues with an advance automation software created by the company. Because of my UI experience, i can quickly related to user experience and resolve their concerns as well as troubleshoot and fix their issues.

During this time, my curiosities were drown into Blockchain technologies so I begin to learn the in and out of this technology. To be able to learn I need a hand on experience so I came up with my own projects and began to work on it. Because of this curiosities, I has added NodeJS, React and MongoDB into my skill sets as well as enhancing existing skills such as JavaScript, Java, C/C++, HTML, HTML5. CSS, SQL, Github, Restful services/API, XML, Hibernate.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Apache Airflow · Git · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud Dataflow · Redis · Back-End Web Development · Spring Framework · Angular · Google BigQuery · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · AngularJS · Solidity · Spring Boot · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Docks · React.js · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Blockchain Developer
positions.description:
Creating new alternate cryptocurrencies upon request from blockchain communities using C/C++.
Building a multi cryptocurrency wallet bot where users have control over their private keys. 
Integrating Bitcoin-base APIs using Nodejs and Mongodb with Discord bots.
Creating and implementing blockchain asic resistants mining algorithms.
Building Bitcoin-based explorer websites.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Docker Products · Node.js · Docks · C++

positions.title: Software and Support Engineer Level 3
positions.description:
Troubleshooting and debugging customer technical issues with Java backend and Javascript  front-end frameworks in development and production environments.
Improved customer systems facing performance issues.
Improving systems based on customer UIX
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web applications using Java and J2EE frameworks for backends and Google Polymer, JavaScript, HTML, JQuery for frontends.
Automating test cases using TestCompete.
Developing common web components by polymerizing common web elements.
Cooperate and communicate with other agile team members to debug and mutually assist.
Integrating UI with java Fabric layer from JavaScript

positions.title: Staff Engineer 3
positions.description:
Responsible for the design and development of web application using java based tools such as: GWT, Eclipse, and Oracle EJB.
Implemented web applications using Java and J2EE frameworks.
Deployed and maintained web applications using Oracle Web Logic, Red Hat Linux, Oracle Database, AJAX and JSP.
Cooperated and communicated with the end users, and functional domain leads to refine requirements as well as development efforts.
Integrating UI with various backend technologies: Oracle EJB, Restful service, SSO authentication, JSON, AJAX.
Designing detailed requirements from higher level requirements and designing UI applications using wireframe.
Overseeing offshore developers completing web applications based on project requirements.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II
positions.description:
Responsible for developing web applications for CLL research consortium using java based tools such as: GWT, Eclipse, and Hibernate.
Responsible for GWT development to enhance front end user experience.
Development of Hibernate DAO and Bean layers.
Establishing communication between GWT with CaGrid web services for storage and retrieval of data.
Creation of GWT History Widgets to work with GWT Javascript history.
Creation of Form Widgets with validation to seamlessly implement various web forms.
Implementation of Web Services using CaGrid Web Service API.
Implementation of remote procedure calls (RPC) between GWT Client and GWT server.
Collaborative team work using JIRA and SVN to track progress.
Installation and deployment of web applications to Tomcat and JBoss servers on  Linux/Unix systems.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II
positions.description:
Responsible for developing web applications using java based tools such as: GWT, Eclipse, and Hibernate. 
Development of a Web Application for museum researchers using Google Web Toolkit for front-end implementation. 
Implementing Hibernate and MySQL to store data in back-end applications.
Training student workers in web application development using the Google Web Toolkit.
Installation and deployment of the web applications to Tomcat servers on Unix systems.

company.name: The Museum of Vertebrate Zoology at Berkeley
